steps.instruction: Compare each reading file with the field list, and find scans with no reading and readings with no scan.
Fill one spreadsheet row per scan, exactly as read; unclear or low-confidence values stay out of the row.
List every unclear, low-confidence or missing field and all client text for a person to check.
Write a short report with the counts and how many rows wait for a person.
